	[CREATURE_CLASS:ALL_CREATURES][DESCRIPTION:A humanoid with physical traits similar to ancient birds and reptiles, covered with rough scales and feathers. It has the head and tail of a lizard but with sharp talons and an elongated muzzle filled with cruel teeth. Behind its inscrutable eyes lurks a dark and evil intelligence capable of both manipulating tools and devising complex strategies. With many others of its kind it scours the vast expanses of the continent, traversing forest and river in search of prey.]
